$comment: Version/source matrix for this project's third-party libraries AND for bbc/audiowaveform itself (the tool being compiled — tracked the same way as a dependency, per the user's explicit request 2026-09-12 to mirror php-wasm-compiler's matrix.json/update-lib-versions.mjs mechanism here too, see CLAUDE.md). 'latest' resolves to the last entry of a library's 'versions' array (compile/Makefile reads it via matrix-version.mjs's MATRIX_VERSION macro). Refresh with `node compile/update-lib-versions.mjs --write`.

audiowaveform.note: The tool this whole project extracts and compiles, not a C dependency — included here anyway so it gets the same version-tracking treatment. Verified via `gh api repos/bbc/audiowaveform/tags` 2026-09-12: real, actively maintained tags (unlike libmad/libid3tag below).

libmad.note: Last real upstream release, 2004 (SourceForge "mad" project). Verified 2026-09-12 via `gh api repos/markjeee/libmad` that the unofficial GitHub mirror has zero tags — there is no "latest" to track here, this is a fixed pin against a dead upstream, unlike audiowaveform/libsndfile below. update-lib-versions.mjs skips this entry (sourceType "tarball", not github-release/github-tag).

libid3tag.note: Same SourceForge "mad" project and dead-upstream situation as libmad above.

libz.note: Hard, unconditional dependency of libid3tag's configure (no --without-zlib option exists) — found via a real build failure, 2026-09-12. Downloaded from zlib.net directly (not GitHub release assets), but tracked against madler/zlib's tags for version-checking purposes, same convention as libcurl's entry in php-wasm-compiler's own matrix.json.

libsndfile.note: WAV/AIFF/RAW/FLAC/Ogg-Vorbis/Ogg-Opus (ENABLE_EXTERNAL_LIBS=ON as of 2026-09-12, ENABLE_MPEG=OFF — see compile/libsndfile/Dockerfile), built against the libogg/libflac/libvorbis/libopus entries below.

libogg.note: Ogg container bitstream layer, needed by libvorbis and by libsndfile's own Ogg-Opus demuxing. Real GitHub tags are "v{version}" (the sourceTemplate above adds the "v" itself) — matrix.json stores the bare version, same convention update-lib-versions.mjs's normalizeVersion() already produces.

libflac.note: Native FLAC decoding for libsndfile (WITH_OGG=OFF — no Ogg FLAC support needed). Unlike libogg/libvorbis/libopus, xiph/flac's tags have no "v" prefix.

libvorbis.note: Ogg Vorbis decoding for libsndfile. Depends on libogg.

libopus.note: Ogg Opus decoding for libsndfile. Standalone at build time (no libogg dependency).

libfaad2.note: M4A/AAC decoding (CLAUDE.md decision 9's correction #2 — chosen over libfdk-aac, which is very likely GPL-incompatible). Only the core libfaad decoder library is built by compile/libfaad2/Dockerfile; the frontend's mp4read.c/unicode_support.c demuxer files are pulled from this same build stage's source tree directly into compile/audiowaveform/Dockerfile's build, not built via faad2's own frontend build system.
